title: CreatorStoryActions

oneOf.description: Replace the whole story tag list (user order). CAS on the tags revision from resource.get/previous write. Blank/duplicate/over-limit tags are rejected (no silent dedupe).

script.description: Optional. Absent creates an empty script. Present, including an empty string, is stored as the script.

aiPrompt.description: Optional. Absent omits the AI prompt section. An empty string is an explicit empty prompt, not an omitted field.

content.description: Shot text. Plain text is stored as the story_text_v1 shot title. A story_text_v1 shot envelope is stored as that shot. This action does not write the retired storyboard graph.

expectedRevision.description: chapterContentFingerprint, the same value as fieldRevisions.content

aiPrompt.description: Empty string clears the AI prompt section. Omitting the field is rejected.

oneOf.description: W5 A501: multi-field story meta patch; each key in fields needs expectedRevisions[key] (field_revision). Stale -> REVISION_STALE, in-action rollback.
W5 A502: role detail patch via RoleDisplayNameService.save_role_detail_panel(node_only). CAS on field_revision(role content).

roleVisualContract.description: Existing roleVisualContract V1 draft; saved by the role detail service. Partial fields remain missing, never forged ready.

oneOf.description: W5 A503: replace story bible JSON (same path as save_story_bible_content: normalize + style_domain mirror). INV-BIBLE-SAVE-01: empty characters over non-empty -> BIBLE_CHARACTERS_OVERWRITE_REJECTED unless forceClearCharacters. expectedRevision = field_revision(current bible content, "" if none).
W5 A503: merge-patch prop content (unknown keys e.g. visualSeed preserved). CAS on field_revision(prop content).
Create one role in the specified story from supplied content. 创建故事角色；无需演员图片，不自动绑定演员或接入画布。
W5 A502: move role to story recycle bin (StoryEntityRecycleService).
W5 A502: restore role from recycle bin; not recycled -> RESTORE_NOOP.
W5 A503: create story prop (StoryPropContentV1). Produces propId. Compensation: hard delete.
W5 A503: move prop to recycle bin.
W5 A503: restore prop from recycle bin.

Soft-link a story prop card to an existing global prop asset (same as UI link_story_prop_asset). Writes story_props.prop_asset_id only; does not set prop_assets.story_id. expectedPropAssetId is the current link (empty string when unlinked).
Clear the soft link from a story prop card to its global prop asset (same as UI unlink_story_prop_asset). expectedPropAssetId must equal the current linked asset id.
Attach the exact fromNodeId/toNodeId using edgeType, for example role_uses_actor. 绑定故事角色与演员身份；不选定装照、不创建画布连线、不生成内容。
Detach the exact relationship edgeId in this story. 解除角色或资产关系；不删除两端资产或它们的媒体。

W5B A501: list move (LayoutService *_apply_move). CAS: expectedOrder must equal current ids. S74: listKind=segmentPlayOrder (parentId=sceneId) moves segment play order via SegmentPlayOrderService (IPC segment_play_order_move + scene chapter-plan write guard); independent of shot numbers; no pin.
W5B A501: pin/unpin to top (LayoutService *_pin_to_top/_unpin).
W5B A501: insert chapter before/after anchor (commands::chapter_insert::insert_chapter_at_core).
W5B A501: physical delete (commands::delete::delete_node_core). Irreversible: must be alone + confirm=true.
W5B A501: ContentHistoryService.restore_node_content_version. CAS on field_revision(content).
W5B A501: rename a history entry (must belong to nodeId).
W5B A501: delete history range. Irreversible: alone + confirm=true.
Create an actor card from supplied content; no photo is required. 创建演员；不自动创建故事角色、连线或生成定装照。

storyId.description: CC22 / V3: optional. Omit storyId for a standalone Cast actor with no story link (same as the Cast tab without a target story); never write null or the string "null". A string or action reference must resolve to an existing story id. Never pick or create a story implicitly.

content.description: The actor card as an object (not a JSON string): name is required; keyInfo, imagePrompt and portraitExtractedHints are optional text (omit when empty).

storyId.description: CC22 / V3: optional. Omit storyId for a standalone Cast actor with no story link (same as the Cast tab without a target story); never write null or the string "null". A string or action reference must resolve to an existing story id. Never pick or create a story implicitly.
